links.comparator_used: Post hoc recalibration on an external calibration subset compared with the same model before recalibration
links.outcome: Hold-out external validation discrimination and probability accuracy/calibration
links.effect: AUC 0.826 vs. 0.810; Brier score decreased from 0.286 to 0.109; log loss from 1.253 to 0.388; calibration intercept 0.103; slope 0.684
links.tradeoff: Discrimination was slightly lower after recalibration (AUC 0.810 vs. 0.826 before recalibration).
links.quote: In the hold-out validation subset, discrimination remained robust both before and after recalibration (AUC 0.826 vs. 0.810), while probability accuracy improved significantly (Brier score decreased from 0.286 to 0.109; log loss from 1.253 to 0.388).
